title: Separate a physical-time gap from a reaction-count gap
statement: For R={0<->A+B,B<->2B} and the accepted clock containing all catalyst vectors of degree<=fixedK, let S_n={(n,0),(n+1,1)} at fixed positive activities. From(n,0) the next firing enters(n+1,1); there the return intensity is order n^(K+1), while combined escapes have order n^K. Thus next-firing escape is O(1/n). The embedded firing chain has stationary rho proportional pi_lambda(x)q(x), finite by factorial tails and polynomial intensities. Its indicator-S_n Dirichlet/variance ratio is O(1/n) and rho(S_n)->0, so its L2(rho) Poincare gap is ZERO despite the positive population-uniform CONTINUOUS-TIME gap. This excludes transferring that clock gap to a bounded jump-kernel perturbation argument; it is not a no-go for all catalytic designs or physical-time robustness.
